manualDescription: Add owned guidance and reference assets after reviewing the scan.
reviewDescription: Review extracted and inferred evidence before accepting it. Candidate colors stay separate from Genfeed product tokens.
startDraft: Scan a website or create a manual draft to start an identity revision.
snapshotHelp: Writing edits save to the live agent profile. Review the versioned snapshot separately before approving it.

preview.label: Local brand preview
preview.title: Preview · {source}
preview.creditFree: Local template · no generation · no credits. Draft previews do not change the approved identity.
preview.description: Add your brand description to see it here.

slots.logosDescription: Keep every version of your logo. The primary logo is your brand avatar. Watermarks on light footage use the light-background version when there is one.
slots.platformDescription: One image per platform, at the size that platform asks for. Uploads are cropped to fit.
slots.sizeSource: Size from the platform's help page
slots.fillEmptyFromMaster: Fill empty slots from master banner
slots.fillHelp: Filled slots are resized and cropped from your master banner. Upload a dedicated image for the sharpest result.
slots.filled: {count, plural, one {# slot filled} other {# slots filled}}
slots.noMaster: Upload a master banner to fill the platform slots from it.

fonts.description: Upload your own fonts, then pick one for headings, body text and captions under Font roles.
fonts.formatHelp: Fonts upload as WOFF2, up to 4 MB. Convert a TTF or OTF file to WOFF2 first, for example with the open source woff2_compress tool or the web font download from your font vendor.
fonts.notWoff2: Only WOFF2 files can be uploaded. Convert TTF or OTF fonts to WOFF2 first.
fonts.removeFailed: The font could not be removed.
fonts.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
fonts.title: Brand fonts
fonts.tooLarge: Fonts can be at most 4 MB.
fonts.uploadFailed: The font could not be uploaded.
